tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi zhal gdams gung bsgrigs

te nyams su len bde ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi ri bong dbab bzung la ni/ don gsum ste/ rig ma brtag cing dgug pa dang*/ sta gon sbyangs pa las la sbyar ba 'phros dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dkar mo dpral bar sme ba yod pa budhi'i rigs/ dmar mo lte bar sme ba yod pa dpral bar rtse gsum yod pa rin chen rigs/ dkar la dmar ba mgrin par sme ba can/ skyes pas reg na mi bzod pa padma'i rigs/ sngo bsangs nu phrag dog pa rna ba g.yon pa la sme ba can las kyi rigs/ sngo bsangs snying ga la sme ba can thugs kyi rigs yin no/ /zhes su ka siddhi'i gsung ngo*/ /dung can ma la gnas lnga po gang rung du dung dang 'dra ba'i ri mo yod pa/ glang chen ma der sme ba smug po yod pa/ padma can ma thig le'i ri mo yod pa/ ri dwags can ma ri mo sgur pau rgyab sprod du yod pa/ ri mo can ma la ri mo drang po gsum/ lcug phran ma la lnga/ chos 'byung ma la gru gsum 'byung ba'o/ /de dag la bde ba myur ba dang*/ stong nyams che ba dang*/ bde ba rgyas pa dang*/ bde ba 'bring ba dang*/ thig le 'dzin sla ba dang*/ gsal nyams che ba dang*/ bde ba shug che ba rnams kyi dgos pa yod/ ces gang ga dha ras gsung ngo*/ /yang kha'i mchu la bha ga brtag /mchu 'thug ma bha ga sha rgyas/ kha che chung la bha ga che chung yod/ bha ga ni lo dgu la sor lnga/ bcu drug la mkhyud gang*/ nyi shu la sor bcu gnyis che tshad yin/ /de las dkyus ring ba mi brten no/ /bde ba che chung mig la brtag ste/ mig dkyus ring zhing mig 'bras nag pa/ sri kha dang mig 'dzum yod na bzang*/ skra dang nu ma legs na bdag po la gus te/ skra li na rab/ ser na 'bring*/ nag po rkyang pa tha ma'o/ /nu ma 'bur zhing zlum na rab/ rno ba 'bring*/ 'phyang ba tha ma'o/ /ol mdud dang snying spu 'dug na gsang thub par 'ongs/ bha ga yang spu med pa dang*/ nag po 'thug po dang*/

ser kham gsum rab mtha' 'bring*/ bha ga phyi dkar la nang dmar ba dang*/ smug pa dang*/ sngo ba rnams spyir sha mdog dkar ba gzhir bzhag pa la rab 'bring tha ma ste/ lce dang snying las bha ga'i kha dog dang*/ mchan khung gi spu las de'i spu brtag dgos te/ de dang de dag mtshungs par 'ong ngo*/ /zhes kun tu bzang mos gsungs so/ /drug pa ni/ bu mo de'i chu shul gyi sa la gzugs brnyan byas/ snying khar gi haṃ dang padma raktas ming rus bris pa'i shog dril gzhug /dgugs gzhug bya/ zangs kyi ling ga'am/ khab kyis bha ga 'tshag cing*/ ha ri ni sa ༵chgaie mo khug rnam shes breng breng dung dung bdag gi dbang du bsdus/ zhes zhag bdun bzlas pa'i bza' btung byin na dbang du 'dus so/ /yang ye shes mkha' 'gro ma su ka siddhi'i gnyan ston la dngos su gnang ba'i dgug pa zab mo ni/ rdzas sbal pa'i ming rus bris la gzhug /yungs dkar bdun nang du gzhug /bdun sbal pa'i 'og tu bcug /rang phag mo'i thugs ka nas pho nya dmar mo mang po spros/ khams gsum dbang du bsdus par bsam la/ ngag bcad de/ swāhā sbal sha khol/ tsag tsag /dung dung*/ 'dur 'dur yed yed chgai mo'i tsitta dkrugs/ bdag gi dbang du gyur cig /ces sems ma g.yeng bar rab zhag gcig /'bring gnyis/ tha ma gsum/ rmi lam du bud med 'du ba/ khrom 'tshogs pa/ gter rnyed pa sogs 'byung ngo*/ /las sbyor ni nyi ma dmar thag chod pa na/ rdzas la sngags stong tsam bzlas/ rab phyi'i nyungs dkar gtor ba/ 'bring sha la brlan pa tsam dang*/ tha ma'i sbal ba lus la thebs na the tshom med/ lus 'khyor ba dang sems mi gnas pa yongs nyen yod/ de la 'dod pa spyad pas sel/ grol bar 'dod na gangs chu grang mo lus la rgyab/ sngags mgo 'jug bzlog /sbal ba bcag /ming rus spos chus khrus byas pas brol bar 'gyur ro/ /rtsa 'tshol ba ni/ spyi bor gla rtsi/ tsandan dkar po/ til mar gsum bsres pas mnyes/

rga shing steng du mkhal ma gnon pa dang*/ shing leb dang ske rag bsdoms/ bshang lam du 'be ldogs 'phying bu bcug pas bha ga'i mkhur sha nu ma 'dra bar 'gro/ rtsa'i rtse mor rib rib 'ong*/ yang na bcos ma'i rdo rjes phyi nas btsags/ nang du bskor bas rtsa yod par phrad pa la 'khun zhing sdang yed pa 'ong*/ rtsa sbom na padma dkar po'i rtsa ba dgos te bod du mi rnyed pas/ ug chos me tog rtsa ba bcas pa/ ba dkar po'i 'o ma/ ka ra/ mar sar/ gangs sbal/ da byid smug po'i tshil sbyar ba byug pa'am/ chang dang sbyar padmar dag pas phra bar 'gyur ro/ /rgya tshos kyi khu ba chu rtsa'i me la skol/ spangs rgyan me tog btab pa btung pa dang*/ gnyer po cher gser gyi me rtsa byed pa/ bha gar chu dugs dang*/ 'phongs tshos la ber gas dal bus brdung ba sogs ni srid rgyun skem pa'o/ /gnyis pa bum pa can brtan po sgom pa yin na/ 'khrul 'khor rnams las la sbyar ba'i skabs su dgos na'ang*/ da lta nas sbyang dgos pas thams cad la rlung 'khrab sngon du gtong bar shes par bya'o/ /'dzin pa la gsum gyi dang po klod pa ni/ lus sems khong klod/ srin po la yan pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgya mtsho bcer ba sogs 'gyur ba bzhi'o/ / gsum pa sems kyi 'khrul 'khor te/ bde ba'i ngo bo la bltas nas klod pa'o/ /bzlog pa la lnga'i dang po ni/ spyi bor rdo rje thal mo 'then la/ stong 'dren byas la sems nam mkhar 'phang ngo*/ /langs te lan gsum skyed cing stong 'dren byed/ gnyis pa ni/ pus btsugs rdo rje khu tshur mdun du btsugs la hag hig hog ces/ snying kha mgrin pa/ spyi bo rnams su drang ngo*/ /gsum pa ni rtsal sprugs kyi mthar/ steng rlung phyir 'phangs*/ thur sel 'then/ skyil krung rdo rje khur tshur brla sgang la btsugs te rgang 'dren bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni sems skyil stod skyil bcas nas/ smad kyi rlung khong 'dren dang*/ sto 'dren bya'o/

/lnga pa ni lag pa g.yon brkyang/ g.yas dpung par khu tshur bcangs/ rkang pa rta la g.yon zhon byed tshul gyis/ g.yon nas rkang 'then bya/ de nyid mgo bzlog re'ang bya'o/ / dgram pa la dgu las/ dang po ni/ langs te slar bsdad thal mo rtsegs lag pa brkyang*/ mgo bo la thal cag re mos su rdeg pa dang*/ 'phag cing lag pa'ang sbrug go /gnyis pa ni/ sgur la lang rkang lag re mos su 'khrab po/ /gsum pa ni/ skyil krung lag gnyis dpung 'dzin pho khar bsnol/ bzhi sprug byas nas mchan khung rdeb cing 'phags pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje skyil krung dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur mkhal ma'i thad du btsug la/ g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du brteg cing 'then no/ /brgyad pa ni/ gdung sna sogs la 'jus te brkyang bskum bya'o/ /dgu pa ni/ gan rkyal dang kha phub rung sug bzhi phyogs bzhir rgyangs nas bcud la bor ro/ /de dag la 'dren kun la smad sgrim stod glod rgya mtsho gcer ba sogs gang 'grub dgos/ 'grems kun la kha sbyor lus lhod cing 'chun dang ldan pa dgos so/ /kun khyab tu sedge rnam grol yang bya'o/ /de dag la sdom 'di skad ces bya ste/ glod dang 'gyur bzhi gzhom pa ste/ /'dzin pa rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /rdo rje khu tshur pus btsugs dang*/ /rtsal sprug khong 'dren rta zhon tshul/ /'dren pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam lnga'o/ /dgram pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnam dgu ni/ /dang po mgo lcog 'phang sprug bya/ /gnyis pa rkang lag re mos 'khrab/ /gsum pa dpung 'dzin bzhi sprug rdeb/ /bzhi pa mkhal mnan pho ba bskor/ /lnga drug lag sprug gan rkyal phra/ /bdun pa sug bzhi g.yas g.yon 'then/ /brgyad dgu brkyang bskum gan rkyal rgyangs/ /'di dag mkha' 'gro gsum gyi man ngag gung spros pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ dbab bzung bzlog dgram rlung dang bsre ba/ ye shes chen por bsre ba'o/ /su kha siddhi 'dod yon lnga la rims slob mi bzhed/

gaṃ ga dha ra ro la bslab pa nas/ reg bya spyi dang*/ rdo rje padmar reg pa yan chad sdoms pa la thun gcig tu mdzad pa yin/ kun tu bzang mo ni/ glu la nyan pa dang*/ gzugs la blta' ba dang*/ ku re byed pa dang*/ lus kyi rtsed mo dang*/ lag bcangs dang*/ 'o dang 'khyud pa dang*/ so dang sen mos 'debs pa dang*/ bde reg byed pa dang*/ phyi rol du drud pa ste drug /phyi'i reg bya la bslab pa dang*/ snyoms par 'jug pa de chags spyod bdun du bzhed do/ /de la rdo rje padmar cung zad gsor zhing*/ nor bur huṃ nag po mgo gyen bstan gyis bkag par bsam/ 'dzin pa'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis pas 'dzin pa yin/ zin dka' na hūṃ gi phul nas thig le ba thag lta bu spyi bor lhan lhan bstim par bsam la hūṃ 'dren drag tu bya'o/ /de nas lus kun sprug cing gling bzhi 'phang ba dang*/ bskyang bskum bya'o/ /yang dang por dal bu dang mthar drag tu srub pas rang dang rig ma gnyis ka'i thig le zhu bar byas/ de nas mi srubs par rgya mtsho sbyar te huṃ 'dren drag po byas la/ rig ma 'od du zhu nas rdo rjer drangs te rang lus khyab pas mdangs rgyas par mos/ des shes rab ma'i padmar grang sing ba dang*/ khyur khyur drangs pa'i nyams dang*/ bde ba zug ngur dang bcas pa mi bzod pa byung na 'dren thub pa'i rtags so/ /su kha'i lugs so/ /yang sha chen dug phyung ba ba dmar po'i 'o mar bcos/ shing kun dang kha ru tshwa btab pa brten/ mchil pa'i sha dang*/ da byid kyang btang*/ lug sha dang chang 'jam po dum re brten/ ra mo sha'i kha da dang*/ zho ma dkrogs pa gza' bas bdag dang rig ma gnyis ka lus zung bskyed/ rtsa ring na rkang pa brkyangs/ thung na rig ma'i rkang pa phrag la bkal nas spyod/ padma'i nang gi g.yas g.yon steng 'og tu rdo rjes drud brud pas rtsa rtsal/ rig mas kyang 'og rlung bskum steng rlung mnon pas rtsa gter bar bya/ thig le 'byung ba snyams byed na 'phongs bsgrad mig gyen du blta'i/

shes rab mas sked pa nyag btang la/ rlung gsang gnas su phul nas zin yongs la de nas drangs/ yang bde ba yal du mi 'jug par bskyod cing 'bebs/ /bde bas sprid nas 'phongs 'byed mi thub na lag pas dbye'o/ /gang ga dha'i lugs so/ /phal cher de dang 'dra ba la mig gyen du gtad/ pus mo la lag pa bkab/ hūṃ rang gis mthar hig gi 'dren yun ring sbyangs nas/ lcam pa'i rkang 'jam po rdo rje bu gar cung zad 'jug cing*/ mthar rtsa bar lhan gyis gtong*/ de nas de 'dren pa la bslab/ de nas mdun mnan te 'phongs 'byed 'dzum gyis dbyung ba la bslab/ de nas dngos gzhi la 'jug / 'dzin pa la sems kyi them bu ste/ 'khrul 'khor gsum pa dang*/ rting pas gnon pa kho na yin no/ /kun tu bzang mo'i lugs so/ /de nas thams cad la yang rus sbal 'gros kyi phab/ so so'i man ngag gis phyag rgya la sbyor bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ bzung bzlog gang 'grub bya/ de nas 'dren lnga dang 'grems dgu po de rnams ci rigs par bya/ thams cad la seṅge'i rnam rol gang mang byas te/ bzlog pa dang khyab par bya'o/ /de nas bum pa can gang mang bsgom ste rlung dang bsre'o/ /ye shes chen por skyel ba ni sgyu lus sbas don dang 'dra'o/ /ma rgyud spyi'i rdzogs rim mkha' 'gro rnam gsum gyi gsang lam bshad zin to// //'di la gzhung shing yig rnying kho na las phyis yi ge gsar pa'i bsre slad med cing*/ phyis kyi yi ge 'khrul 'khor nyi shu pa dang*/ nyer gcig zer ba gnyis gda' na'ang*/ gzhan nas rkus shing khung med la/ phyi ma rnams 'di yang ni gu'i gsang khridayin zer ba ni ches 'khrul lo/ /'di la yig rnying yig chung drug yod do/ /athi+-i/ zhes pa 'di'ang lcags zom chos rje/ rig 'dzin mkha' spyod dbang po'i nyams len du mkho bar bsam nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/
